components.name: Dining table straight centre
components.function: Missing dining-table modules and supporting furniture; existing chairs and celebration tea set reused
components.construction: A RECTANGULAR straight centre module for an oval table, 2m width,2.2m length,0.76m height. Rose/ivory marble top, fine gold perimeter only along the TWO LONG SIDE EDGES, four slender lotus legs with open space beneath. BOTH SHORT ENDS are precisely STRAIGHT flat joining planes, no rounded cap, decorative hanging piece or gold lip across joining edge. Top height and apron section must match S02. Show a dashed assembly guide with one S02 attached to each short end, forming ONE2x4.2m oval table. This small guide is not a fifth asset.

components.notes: All four intended furniture types are present. S01 has a rectangular central top with exposed straight cut edges; S02 has a semicircular end with a straight diameter. Assembly guide shows centre plus two copies of the end. Human-scale dimensions and palette follow the proposed contract. S02 main and contact views show two legs, but its small underside view appears to add extra corner legs. The two-leg declaration and main view control the intended end module; underside image is not reliable topology. S01 front view draws a decorated apron across a cut end even though the main view leaves a plain joining face. Remove any transverse apron or cap from both centre cut ends during modeling. Duplicate and rotate this same module for both table ends.
